entries.note: CONFIRMS the artwork<->Global Option link: layer.customization_type='global_option', layer.global_option=862 (the id of QA-GO-IMG-TextToImage-01 created in ACT-01-02-001). 'required' shows true even though the 'Mark this option as required' checkbox was not explicitly checked in this run's Personalization Settings panel — unconfirmed whether this is a default for 'Use an existing global option' or inherited from the referenced Global Option's own data; not concluded, hand off as observation.

cross_object_note_ref: See cross_object_notes in portal-evidence.json: layer type 'Text to Image (AI)' on artwork DID show a 'No personalization' radio option in PERSONALIZATION SETTINGS this run, which contradicts artwork KB-019's statement that text-to-image lacks 'No personalization'. Also: 'Select a global option*' dropdown for this layer only listed Global Option instances whose type also ='text-to-image' (filtered by type-compatibility), i.e. QA-GO-IMG-TextToImage-01 was the only option shown even though 6 other Global Option instances of other types existed at the time.
